import { z } from "zod/v4";

export const nodeSchema: z.ZodObject<{
  value: z.ZodString;
  children: z.ZodArray<z.ZodLazy<typeof nodeSchema>>;
}> = z.object({
  value: z.string(),
  children: z.array(z.lazy(() => nodeSchema)),
});

export type Node = z.infer<typeof nodeSchema>;

export const rightSchema: z.ZodObject<{
  count: z.ZodNumber;
  left: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodLazy<typeof leftSchema>>;
}> = z.object({
  count: z.number(),
  left: z.lazy(() => leftSchema).optional(),
});

export const leftSchema: z.ZodObject<{
  name: z.ZodString;
  right: typeof rightSchema;
}> = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  right: rightSchema,
});

export type Left = z.infer<typeof leftSchema>;
export type Right = z.infer<typeof rightSchema>;
